paragraphs: QUIZZY is a high-performance, real-time multiplayer quiz and trivia platform built with Next.js 16, Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and MongoDB. Players can join 1–4 player competitive rooms via shareable room codes or practice in solo mode, answering questions against server-authoritative timers with dynamic speed scoring and synchronized round reveals.
features: 1–4 Player Real-Time Multiplayer: Room creation, 6-character room codes, shareable invite links, host controls, real-time participant readiness toggles, and live room state synchronization via Socket.IO.
Solo Practice Mode: Immediate single-player drills without waiting for room lobbies.

Server-Authoritative Anti-Cheat: Questions are dispatched round-by-round. Correct answers and explanations remain strictly on the server until the synchronized round reveal. Client timers are representational, and all…
Dynamic Speed Scoring: Correct answers award points on a decaying curve:
$$\text{Score} = \max(100, 1000 - (\text{elapsedSeconds} \times 30))$$ Incorrect or timed-out submissions award 0 points.

requirements.text: Native JWT: User registration and login with PBKDF2 password hashing (100,000 iterations, SHA-512), 15-minute access tokens, and rotating 7-day refresh tokens stored as SHA-256 hashes in MongoDB and HttpOnly cookies.
Interactive OpenAPI / Swagger Documentation: Self-hosted Swagger UI available at /api/docs.
